paper.title: CEPO: RLVR Self-Distillation using Contrastive Evidence Policy Optimization
paper.abstract: When a model produces a correct solution under reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), every token receives the same reward signal regardless of whether it was a decisive reasoning step or a grammatical filler. A natural fix is to condition the model on the correct answer as a teacher, identifying tokens it would have generated differently had it known the answer. Prior work shows this either corrupts training by leaking the answer into the gradient, or produces a weak signal that

summary.core_problem: 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）现有方法存在信用分配缺陷：GRPO给正确轨迹所有token分配相同奖励，浪费梯度信号，无法区分关键推理token和填充token；RLSD的证据比存在流畅度混淆、负信号不对称、证据单一三类问题，此前的自蒸馏方法还存在答案信息泄露的训练偏差。
summary.importance: 提出了更精准的RL后训练token级信用分配方案，提升了推理类任务的训练效率和最终性能，对当前RL预训练、推理增强预训练的信号优化方向有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出对比证据策略优化（CEPO），将RLSD使用的「正确答案条件分布/学生分布」的证据比，替换为「正确答案条件分布/错误答案条件分布」的对比式比值，其中错误答案来自同批次已被拒绝的生成结果。该设计天然消除流畅度混淆，符合贝叶斯差分信念更新的解释，同时完整保留RLSD无信息泄露、奖励方向锚定的安全保证，RLSD是CEPO在错误答案无有效信息时的特殊情况。
summary.experiments: 在5个多模态数学推理基准上，2B和4B参数规模下，CEPO比基线分别获得3.7%和2.2%的准确率提升，训练收敛速度显著快于GRPO和RLSD，更高的权重天然集中在算术、推理相关的关键token位置。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读Introduction部分的问题分析，Method章节的核心比值设计，实验部分的收敛曲线和关键token权重分布可视化结果，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) methods have credit assignment flaws: GRPO assigns identical reward to all tokens in a correct trajectory, wastes gradient bandwidth and fails to distinguish decisive reasoning tokens from filler tokens. RLSD's evidence ratio has three limitations including fluency confound, asymmetric negative signal and one-sided evidence, while prior self-distillation methods also face training bias from answer information leakage.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a more accurate token-level credit assignment solution for RL post-training, improves training efficiency and final performance on reasoning tasks, and provides reference for signal optimization in ongoing RL pretrain and reasoning-enhanced pretraining research.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Contrastive Evidence Policy Optimization (CEPO), which replaces RLSD's evidence ratio of (correct-answer conditioned distribution / student distribution) with a contrastive ratio of (correct-answer conditioned distribution / wrong-answer conditioned distribution), where wrong answers are sampled from rejected generations in the same training batch. This design eliminates fluency confound by construction, fits the Bayesian differential belief update interpretation, and retains all structural safety guarantees of RLSD including no information leakage and reward sign anchoring. RLSD is a limiting case of CEPO when the wrong answer carries no valid information.
summary_en.experiments: Across 5 multimodal mathematical reasoning benchmarks, CEPO achieves 3.7% and 2.2% accuracy improvements over baseline at 2B and 4B parameter scale respectively. It converges significantly faster than GRPO and RLSD during training, and higher weight is naturally concentrated at token positions related to arithmetic and inferential decisions.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the problem analysis in Introduction, core ratio design in Method section, convergence curves and key token weight distribution visualization in experiments. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和消融即可；如果实验干净，CEPO 是值得复现的 RLVR token 信用分配基线。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations; if the setup is clean, CEPO is a plausible baseline to reproduce for RLVR token-level credit assignment.

paper.title: Flash-GRPO: Efficient Alignment for Video Diffusion via One-Step Policy Optimization
paper.abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization has emerged as essential for aligning video diffusion models with human preferences, but faces a critical computational bottleneck: training a 14B parametered model typically demands hundreds of GPU days per experiment. Existing efficiency methods reduce costs through sliding window subsampling training timesteps, but fundamentally compromise optimization, exhibiting severe instability and failing to reach full trajectory performance. We present Flash-GRPO, a s

summary.core_problem: 现有用于视频扩散模型对齐的GRPO方法计算成本极高，时间步下采样又会导致训练不稳定、性能下降。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出单步GRPO训练框架，大幅降低视频扩散对齐的计算成本，同时提升对齐性能。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Flash-GRPO，用等时间分组消除时间步混淆的方差，用时间梯度矫正消除时间依赖的梯度缩放不一致问题，实现单步训练。
summary.experiments: 低计算预算下对齐质量超过全轨迹训练，14B参数模型训练效率大幅提升。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自浙江大学、清华大学、Joy Future Academy等。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing GRPO for video diffusion alignment has extremely high computational cost, while timestep subsampling leads to training instability and performance degradation.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposes a single-step GRPO training framework that drastically reduces computational cost for video diffusion alignment while improving alignment quality.
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose Flash-GRPO: use iso-temporal grouping to eliminate timestep-confounded variance, use temporal gradient rectification to neutralize time-dependent gradient scaling inconsistency, enabling single-step training.
summary_en.experiments: Outperforms full-trajectory training in alignment quality under low compute budget, drastically improves training efficiency for 14B parameter models.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Zhejiang University, Tsinghua University, Joy Future Academy, etc.

recommendation.zh: GRPO单步训练和梯度矫正的思路可参考用于LLM对齐的效率优化，看方法部分摘要即可。
recommendation.en: The ideas of single-step GRPO training and gradient rectification can be referenced for LLM alignment efficiency optimization, only read method summary.

paper.title: VSPO: Vector-Steered Policy Optimization for Behavioral Control
paper.abstract: Modern language models often need to optimize a primary accuracy objective while also accommodating secondary behavioral preferences, such as verbosity, agreeableness, or the level of technical expertise in its response. In practice, a base model may exhibit a desired behavior very rarely or not at all. Thus, endowing the model with a target behavior creates a sparse behavioral reward bottleneck. To address such multi-objective problems, we introduce Vector-Steered Policy Optimization (VSPO) whi

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 post-training 里的一个常见但不太好做的问题：模型既要保持主目标上的正确性，又要学会稀疏出现的次级行为偏好，比如更简洁、更有技术深度、更温和或更自信。直接用 GRPO 加行为奖励时，若目标行为在当前策略采样中很少自然出现，就会遇到 sparse behavioral reward bottleneck：大多数 rollout 都缺少可比较的行为差异，导致相对优势信号很弱，训练效率低。作者要解决的核心问题是：在不依赖频繁 teacher 在线重写、也不直接训练在 teacher 的 off-policy 轨迹上的前提下，如何让 RL 过程更稳定地学到可控行为。
summary.importance: 从预训练研究的直接相关性看，这篇更偏 post-train，而不是基座预训练本身。但它有两个值得关注的点。第一，它把 steering vector 从推理时控制手段，推进到 RL 训练过程中的 rollout 分布设计工具，这对理解 latent behavior representation 与 policy optimization 的接口有启发。第二，它讨论的是多目标优化里一个很实际的问题：奖励函数只能给结果打分，却不一定能改变 rollout 分布的探索效率。这个视角对后续研究 pretrain ↔ posttrain 接口、行为控制、以及低成本 AI feedback 都有参考意义。贡献量级上属于方法型增量：不是新范式，但在 GRPO/RLAIF/teacher-trace SFT 之间提出了一个折中方案。
summary.technical_approach:
VSPO 的核心做法是：先构造一个与目标行为对应的 steering vector，再在 RL 采样阶段沿着这个向量施加不同强度的 steering，使当前策略生成一组行为强度可控、但仍然来自 student 自身分布的 rollout。之后再用类似 GRPO 的方式做多目标优化，其中行为奖励与 steering 强度成比例。

具体流程分两步。第一步是 steering vector construction。作者先让目标模型对一小批问题生成基础回答，再用更强的 teacher 把这些回答重写成带有目标行为的版本，形成对比 rewrite pairs。基于这些成对样本，在模型激活空间中提取行为方向，得到 steering vector。这里 teacher 只在离线阶段参与一次性向量构造，而不是在每轮 RL 中持续提供重写或打分。

第二步是 vector-steered policy optimization。在训练时，对同一问题按不同 steering intensity 采样多个 rollout，相当于主动扩展当前策略在目标行为轴上的局部探索范围。这样做有两个作用：一是提高行为多样性，让组内比较更有信息量；二是保持 on-policy 属性，因为这些轨迹仍由当前 student 生成，而不是直接模仿 teacher 轨迹。随后作者在 GRPO 框架下定义多目标奖励，主目标通常是任务正确性，次目标是行为偏好；行为项按 steering 强度归一化，使不同强度下的样本可比较。文中还把这一过程解释为一种 latent self-distillation：不是蒸馏 teacher 的文本轨迹，而是在潜在行为方向上引导 student 生成自己的轨迹。

与几类基线相比，区别比较清楚。相对 reward shaping，VSPO 不只是给已有 rollout 打分，而是先改变 rollout 分布，让稀疏行为更容易被采到。相对 teacher-trace SFT，它避免直接在 off-policy teacher 文本上训练。相对 RLAIF/online rewriting，它把 teacher 的使用从在线循环中移到离线向量构造，降低了成本。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 MATH 和 MMLU-Pro，并在四类目标行为上评估。摘要和正文给出的结论是，VSPO 在保持主任务正确性的同时，持续优于 reward shaping、teacher-trace SFT 和 RLAIF 风格基线。作者强调的不是单点分数，而是几个训练性质：
1. 更好的行为控制。通过不同 steering intensity 采样，模型能更稳定地沿目标行为轴移动，而不是偶然出现目标风格。
2. 更小的分布偏移。文中提到 Fig. 6 显示 VSPO 相比替代方案对 base model 的分布扰动更温和，这意味着它在行为控制和能力保持之间的折中更好。
3. 自然课程效应。Fig. 7 展示训练过程中模型会沿行为轴逐步学习，而不是一开始就被强推到高强度行为区间。

理论部分还给出 bandit abstraction 下的迭代复杂度分析，说明在目标行为稀疏时，VSPO 通过上采样这些稀有但有价值的行为模式，可以比单纯 reward-shaped GRPO 更高效。由于当前提供的全文片段没有完整表格数字、模型规模和所有超参数，无法可靠复述具体绝对分数；但从论文结构看，重点不在刷新 benchmark，而在证明 steering 改变 rollout 分布后，RL 信号会更密、更稳定。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，重点看方法动机，不必在 benchmark 表格上停留太久。建议阅读顺序：
1. Introduction，先看作者如何定义 sparse behavioral reward bottleneck，以及为什么 reward shaping、teacher-trace SFT、RLAIF 各自不够理想。
2. Proposed Method，重点看 steering vector 的构造方式，以及训练时如何按不同 intensity 采样 rollout。
3. Section 3.2 的理论分析。如果关心为什么这种方法可能比 reward shaping 更高效，这部分值得看。
4. 实验里的 Fig. 6 和 Fig. 7，分别对应分布偏移和课程效应，是理解方法是否“只是换个技巧”的关键证据。

预计 20 分钟左右可以抓住主要思想。若要判断是否值得复现，重点检查 steering vector 的提取位置、注入层、强度调度，以及行为奖励如何与主任务奖励做归一化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a common post-training problem: optimizing task correctness while also controlling a secondary behavior such as verbosity, agreeableness, confidence, or technical depth. Standard GRPO with an auxiliary behavior reward struggles when the target behavior is rarely expressed by the current policy. In that case, most sampled rollouts look behaviorally similar, relative advantage signals become weak, and learning is inefficient. The core question is how to make behavior learning more sample-efficient and controllable without relying on repeated online teacher rewriting or directly training on off-policy teacher trajectories.
summary_en.importance: This is more of a post-training paper than a pretraining one, but it is still relevant for people thinking about the pretrain-posttrain interface. The interesting part is not the benchmark itself; it is the use of steering vectors as a mechanism for shaping the rollout distribution during RL, rather than only as an inference-time control tool. That gives a concrete link between latent behavior representations and policy optimization. It also highlights a useful point for alignment research: reward functions score outcomes, but they do not necessarily improve exploration over rare behaviors. The contribution is incremental rather than paradigm-shifting, but it is a thoughtful middle ground between reward shaping, teacher-trace SFT, and online AI-feedback methods.
summary_en.technical_approach:
VSPO works in two stages. First, it constructs a steering vector associated with the target behavior. The target model produces base responses for a small set of prompts, and a stronger teacher rewrites those responses to express the desired behavior. These contrastive rewrite pairs are then used to extract a latent direction in activation space, which serves as the steering vector. The teacher is used only in this offline setup stage, not repeatedly inside the RL loop.

Second, during policy optimization, the current policy is rolled out under multiple steering intensities along that vector. This creates a set of student-generated trajectories that vary in behavior strength while remaining anchored to the current policy. The optimization then proceeds in a GRPO-like multi-objective setup, where the primary reward captures task correctness and the behavioral reward is tied to the steering intensity. The paper interprets this as a form of latent self-distillation: instead of training on teacher-written traces, the student generates its own traces under controlled movement in latent behavior space.

The distinction from baselines is clear. Compared with reward shaping, VSPO changes the rollout distribution before scoring it, which helps expose sparse behaviors more often. Compared with teacher-trace SFT, it avoids direct imitation of off-policy teacher outputs. Compared with RLAIF or online rewriting, it removes repeated teacher calls from the training loop and reuses a fixed latent control signal.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are run on MATH and MMLU-Pro with four target behavior types. The main empirical claim is that VSPO consistently outperforms reward shaping, teacher-trace SFT, and RLAIF-style baselines while preserving correctness on the primary task. The paper emphasizes several qualitative properties rather than only endpoint scores.

First, behavior control is more reliable because rollouts are explicitly sampled at different steering intensities, rather than waiting for the desired behavior to appear naturally. Second, the method induces milder distributional shift from the base model; the paper points to Figure 6 for this comparison. Third, it creates a natural curriculum along the behavior axis during training, illustrated in Figure 7, instead of forcing the model immediately into a high-intensity behavior regime.

There is also a theoretical component under a bandit abstraction. The authors argue that when the target behavior is sparse, VSPO improves iteration complexity over reward-shaped GRPO by effectively upsampling rare but useful behavioral patterns. The full text fragment provided here does not include the complete result tables, model sizes, or all absolute numbers, so it would be unsafe to invent exact metrics. The main takeaway is that steering-assisted rollout diversification appears to make RL signals denser and more stable.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Focus on the motivation and the mechanism, not on squeezing every benchmark detail. Read the introduction first to understand the sparse behavioral reward bottleneck and why reward shaping, teacher-trace SFT, and RLAIF each leave something unresolved. Then read the method section carefully, especially how the steering vector is built and how multiple steering intensities are used during rollout generation. If you care about the efficiency argument, read the theory section around the iteration-complexity propositions. In the experiments, Figures 6 and 7 are the most informative because they speak to distribution shift and curriculum effects rather than just final scores.

Roughly 20 minutes should be enough to extract the main idea. If you are considering reproduction, inspect where the steering vector is extracted, how it is injected, how intensity is scheduled, and how the behavioral reward is normalized against the task reward.

recommendation.zh: GRPO的多偏好改进版本，可直接用于多维度对齐的 ablation 实验，仅需阅读第4节的理论证明部分
recommendation.en: This multi-preference GRPO variant can be directly used for multi-dimensional alignment ablation experiments, only read §4 for theoretical proof

paper.title: Learning from Failures: Correction-Oriented Policy Optimization with Verifiable Rewards
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has emerged as an effective paradigm for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models. However, RLVR training is often hindered by sparse binary rewards and weak credit assignment, resulting in ambiguous optimization signals and underutilization of the useful information embedded in failed trajectories. To address this challenge, we propose Correction-Oriented Policy Optimization (CIPO), a simple and effective extension to RL

summary.core_problem: 在 RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）里，二值稀疏奖励导致 credit assignment 弱，失败轨迹被“一刀切”惩罚，既浪费了失败中包含的部分正确推理结构，也让优化信号方向性不足。论文要解决的是：不引入额外标注/外部 critic 的前提下，把 on-policy 失败样本变成更密、更有方向的训练信号。
summary.importance: 属于 post-train（RL）对基座能力的改进，但对“训练信号质量/稀疏奖励如何变稠密”这一类问题有直接启发。它的贡献不是提出新的 reward model 或过程监督，而是给出一种自举式的数据构造：用模型自己的失败输出作为条件，采样“修正解”，把失败轨迹转化为监督学习式的纠错目标，并与 GRPO 类 RL 目标联合优化。对做 RLVR 的团队，这类方法往往比引入额外模型更便宜、更稳定；对 pretrain 研究的间接价值在于：展示了如何把负样本从“抑制项”变成“可学习的局部邻域结构”，改善梯度信号的可用性。
summary.technical_approach:
CIPO（Correction-Oriented Policy Optimization）是在 GRPO/RLVR 框架上的扩展，核心是“失败→纠错监督”的自生成闭环。

- 失败轨迹转纠错对：每轮 on-policy rollout 后，收集失败输出 y_fail。构造新的条件输入（prompt + y_fail），再从当前策略采样 refined solution y_corr。直觉是：不同失败离正确解的距离不同，“near-miss”更容易在局部邻域被修正；这种可修正概率差异会自然提供更细粒度的学习信号，而不是把所有失败等价为负奖励。
- 联合目标：把纠错样本的监督目标（让模型在给定失败尝试的条件下生成正确/更优解）与标准 RLVR/GRPO 目标一起优化。这样既保留 RLVR 的可验证奖励优势，又引入更稠密、更具方向性的梯度。
- 稳定性设计：作者提到三类机制来避免“把失败都学进去”导致策略退化：
  1）自适应平衡成功/失败样本比例；
  2）risk-aversion reward shaping（更保守地处理高风险更新，细节需看方法章节公式）；
  3）基于 on-policy 采样准确率的 rollout preference，保证训练信号持续信息量。

与相关工作的区别：不依赖额外的过程奖励模型/LLM critic；也不同于 SDPO 那类需要更强反馈或反思能力的 teacher 构造。它更像“把失败当作可条件化的上下文”，训练一个显式的自我修正能力。
summary.experiments:
论文在 11 个基准（数学推理+代码）上报告一致收益。给出的关键数字包括：
- 纠错/调试：Seed-Coder-8B 用 CIPO 在 DebugBench 上提升 7.63%，效果达到 Claude-4-sonnet 水平，并超过 GRPO。
- 数学推理：Qwen-3-4B 用 CIPO 在 6 个数学基准上平均准确率提升 17.56%，相对 GRPO 额外提升 4.55%。
- 还报告 pass@K 更高，作者用此论证提升不只是“把概率压到少数解上”，而是扩大了可行解空间/推理能力（需要结合具体 pass@K 曲线与温度设置判断）。

从预训练/训练动态角度，建议重点看：纠错样本占比的调度消融、risk shaping 的 ablation、以及不同失败类型（near-miss vs fundamentally wrong）下纠错成功率与最终收益的对应关系是否被量化。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 40–60 分钟）：
- 先看 Figure 1/2：失败类型异质性与“失败→纠错采样→联合优化”的训练闭环。
- 再读方法章节里联合目标的公式与三项稳定性机制（自适应比例、risk shaping、rollout preference），这是可复现的关键。
- 最后快速扫实验：重点看 DebugBench 与数学 6-benchmark 的主表，以及 pass@K 与消融表。若要落地到自家 RLVR pipeline，优先复现“纠错样本构造 + 比例调度”，再逐步加 shaping 与 preference。

summary_en.core_problem: In RL with verifiable rewards (RLVR), binary sparse rewards make credit assignment weak and treat all failed trajectories as equally negative, wasting partially-correct reasoning in failures and providing ambiguous gradients. The paper targets a task-agnostic way to turn on-policy failures into informative training signals without extra annotations or external critics.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training (RL) contribution, but it directly informs how to improve training signal quality under sparse verification. The key idea is a self-bootstrapped data construction: condition on the model’s own failed attempt and sample a refined solution, then optimize a correction objective jointly with GRPO-style RL. Compared to adding process reward models or LLM critics, it is cheaper and often more stable. For pretraining researchers, the transferable insight is how to convert “negative samples” from pure suppression into learnable local structure that densifies gradients.
summary_en.technical_approach:
CIPO (Correction-Oriented Policy Optimization) extends GRPO/RLVR with a failure-to-correction loop.

- Failure → correction pairs: after on-policy rollouts, collect failed outputs y_fail. Build a new conditioning context (prompt + y_fail) and sample refined solutions y_corr from the current policy. The mechanism leverages heterogeneity of failures: near-miss failures are more correctable in the local neighborhood, implicitly yielding more informative supervision than uniform penalization.
- Joint optimization: train with a correction-style supervised objective on the generated correction samples together with the standard RLVR/GRPO objective, aiming to keep the benefits of verifiable rewards while adding directional, denser gradients.
- Stabilization components: the paper describes (i) an adaptive balance between successful and failed trajectories, (ii) risk-averse reward shaping, and (iii) a rollout preference strategy based on on-policy sampling accuracy to maintain informative updates and avoid policy degradation.

Distinct from prior work: no external process reward model or LLM critic; unlike SDPO-like approaches, it does not rely on strong feedback/reflective teachers. It explicitly trains “self-correction conditioned on own mistakes.”
summary_en.experiments:
Reported results span 11 benchmarks in math reasoning and code generation. Key numbers provided:
- Correction/debugging: Seed-Coder-8B + CIPO gains +7.63% on DebugBench, reaching performance comparable to Claude-4-sonnet and surpassing GRPO.
- Reasoning: Qwen-3-4B + CIPO improves average accuracy by +17.56% across six math benchmarks, with an additional +4.55% over GRPO.
- Higher pass@K is reported, suggesting improvements beyond mere probability sharpening (this should be interpreted alongside sampling settings and pass@K curves).

For deeper understanding, focus on ablations for correction-sample ratio scheduling, risk shaping, rollout preference, and any analysis that correlates failure types with correction success probability and final gains.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (~40–60 min):
- Start with Figures 1–2 to internalize the failure heterogeneity argument and the training loop.
- Read the method section carefully for the joint objective and the three stabilization mechanisms; these are the implementation-critical parts.
- Then scan the main tables on DebugBench and the six math benchmarks, plus pass@K and ablation tables. For practical adoption, first replicate “correction sample construction + ratio scheduling,” then add shaping/preference if needed.

recommendation.zh: 读方法构造和 ablation 即可；失败轨迹转监督是干净的小改动，值得拿来对照 RLVR 信号稀疏问题。
recommendation.en: Read the construction and ablations; turning failed rollouts into supervision is a clean tweak worth testing against sparse RLVR signals.

institutions: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

paper.title: ODRPO: Ordinal Decompositions of Discrete Rewards for Robust Policy Optimization
paper.abstract: The alignment of Large Language Models (LLMs) utilizes Reinforcement Learning from AI Feedback (RLAIF) for non-verifiable domains such as long-form question answering and open-ended instruction following. These domains often rely on LLM based auto-raters to provide granular, multi-tier discrete rewards (e.g., 1-10 rubrics) that are inherently stochastic due to prompt sensitivity and sampling randomness. We empirically verify the stochasticity of auto-raters that can propagate and corrupt standar

summary.core_problem: RLAIF（AI反馈强化学习）中使用的LLM自动评分器存在固有随机性，源于prompt敏感性、位置偏见、采样随机性等因素，导致离散奖励信号噪声大。这类噪声会破坏GRPO、MaxRL等传统优势估计器的归一化统计量，造成学习信号退化；而通过增加采样次数取多数票的降噪方案计算成本过高，无法大规模落地。
summary.importance: 为LLM对齐阶段的RL训练提供了低开销的抗噪声奖励处理方案，能够在不增加显著训练成本的前提下提升RLAIF的稳定性和最终效果，对大规模后训练对齐的工程落地有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出ODRPO框架，将单标量离散奖励分解为多个对应不同序贯成功等级的子奖励，对每个等级独立计算优势后再累加，把单奖励优化转化为多奖励形式。这种序贯分解将评分器的随机性限制在狭窄的边界区间内，避免单个噪声样本破坏全局归一化的均值和方差，保证大部分奖励分布的学习信号稳定。同时引入方差感知加权机制，动态抑制完全达标或当前完全无法达标的评估标准的权重，将模型优化重心放在当前的学习前沿区域。该方案无额外可测量的训练开销，可作为传统优势估计器的即插即用增强组件。
summary.experiments: 在FACTS-grounding-v2、Alpaca-Eval、IFEval三个基准上对比GRPO、MaxRL等基线，ODRPO在FACTS-grounding-v2上取得最高14.8%的相对性能提升，在Alpaca-Eval上取得最高7.5%的相对提升。同时配套的理论分析证明，序贯分解的优势估计器存在良定义的全局标量目标，能够稳定优化轨迹。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读自动评分器方差的实证分析部分、ODRPO的核心算法设计，以及三个基准的主实验结果，理论部分可按需浏览，预计阅读时间20-25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM-based auto-raters used in RLAIF have inherent stochasticity caused by prompt sensitivity, position bias, sampling randomness and other factors, which introduces high noise into discrete reward signals. This noise corrupts the normalization statistics of traditional advantage estimators such as GRPO and MaxRL, leading to degraded learning signals. The common noise reduction approach of sampling multiple rewards and taking majority votes incurs prohibitive computational cost for large-scale deployment.
summary_en.importance: ODRPO provides a low-overhead noise-robust reward processing scheme for RL training during LLM alignment, which improves the stability and final performance of RLAIF without significant additional training cost. It has direct practical reference value for large-scale post-training alignment engineering.
summary_en.technical_approach: The ODRPO framework decomposes a single scalar discrete reward into multiple sub-rewards corresponding to different ordinal success levels. Advantages are computed independently for each level and then accumulated, transforming single-reward optimization into a multi-reward formulation. This ordinal decomposition confines evaluator stochasticity to narrow boundary strata, preventing individual noisy samples from corrupting the global mean and variance used for normalization, and preserving stable learning signals across most of the reward distribution. A variance-aware weighting mechanism is also introduced to dynamically suppress weights of evaluation criteria that are either fully satisfied or currently unreachable, focusing model optimization on the active learning frontier. The scheme introduces no measurable training overhead and can be used as a plug-and-play augmentation for traditional advantage estimators.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated against GRPO and MaxRL baselines on three benchmarks: FACTS-grounding-v2, Alpaca-Eval, and IFEval. ODRPO achieves up to 14.8% relative performance improvement on FACTS-grounding-v2 and up to 7.5% relative improvement on Alpaca-Eval. Theoretical analysis confirms that the ordinal decomposition-based advantage estimator admits a well-defined global scalar objective, which stabilizes the optimization trajectory.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the empirical analysis of auto-rater variance, core algorithm design of ODRPO, and main experimental results on the three benchmarks. Theoretical analysis can be browsed on demand. Estimated reading time: 20-25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 关注 RLAIF 中 reward 噪声对 GRPO 等算法的影响，提出的序数分解思路对优化 post-train 的 reward 信号质量有启发，建议看其对 reward 噪声的建模和消融实验。
recommendation.en: Focuses on the impact of reward noise in RLAIF on algorithms like GRPO; the proposed ordinal decomposition approach is inspiring for optimizing reward signal quality in post-training. Worth checking its noise modeling and ablations.

paper.title: Teacher-Guided Policy Optimization for LLM Distillation
paper.abstract: The convergence of reinforcement learning and imitation learning has positioned Reverse KL (RKL) as a promising paradigm for on-policy LLM distillation, aiming to unify exploration with teacher supervision. However, we identify a critical limitation: when the student and teacher distributions diverge significantly, standard RKL often fails to yield meaningful improvement due to uninformative negative feedback. To address this inefficiency, we propose Teacher-Guided Policy Optimization (TGPO), an

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 on-policy LLM 蒸馏里的一个具体失效点：用 Reverse KL 让学生在自己采样的轨迹上贴近教师，看起来能同时兼容 RL 探索和教师监督，但当学生和教师分布差距较大时，教师只是在事后给学生 token 打分，不能告诉学生应该往哪个 token 移动，梯度容易变成低信息量的惩罚信号。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在模型结构，而在训练信号设计。它提醒我们，KL 方向和采样分布的选择会改变教师信号的性质：RKL 保留了 on-policy 形式，但牺牲了前向指导；SFT 有强指导，但训练状态来自教师分布。TGPO 尝试把两者拆开：状态来自学生 rollout，目标 token 来自教师条件预测。这对小模型推理蒸馏、RLVR 早期训练、以及 pretrain 到 posttrain 的接口设计都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先把 RKL 蒸馏写成学生分布上的期望，并指出它等价于在 RL 目标中加入一个内在奖励：负的 student-teacher log-ratio。问题在于，这个奖励只评价学生已经采出来的动作。如果学生 token 落在教师低概率区域，教师概率接近零，训练信号主要是在压制当前动作，而不是指出替代动作。TGPO 的改法是：仍然让学生生成 on-policy rollout，但在每个学生生成的上下文上查询教师，让教师给出下一步 token 分布或预测 token，然后对学生施加类似 SFT 的 token-level 似然学习。这样，状态分布保持 on-policy，监督信号则从“判别当前 token 好不好”变成“在当前状态下教师会怎么走”。论文还讨论了教师信号放进 reward 还是作为 loss regularization 的设计差别，重点是避免把密集 token 指导退化成稀疏或高方差的奖励估计。
summary.experiments: 实验结论集中在三点。第一，标准 RKL 在学生和教师分布差距较大时训练不稳定，提升有限，和第 2 节的分析一致。第二，TGPO 能在这些远分布场景下继续提供有效更新，因为教师是在学生实际访问的上下文上给出方向性监督。第三，TGPO 与 mixed-policy 类方法相比有竞争力，同时不需要额外人工标注，能够嵌入现有 RLVR 流程。提供的正文片段没有给出完整模型规模、任务集合、表格数值和消融数字；精读时需要核对实验表格中 RKL、TGPO、SFT、mixed-policy 与 RLVR baseline 的具体差距。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25 分钟。先看第 2 节的 RKL 推导，尤其是把 RKL 写成 RL intrinsic reward 的部分，这是理解失效机制的核心。再看 Figure 1 和第 3 节目标函数，确认 TGPO 的教师查询发生在学生 rollout 的哪些位置，以及教师信号最终进入 loss 还是 reward。实验部分重点看三类对比：远分布教师-学生设置、RKL 训练曲线稳定性、TGPO 与 mixed-policy 方法的消融。若只关心预训练训练信号，可重点看 KL 方向分析和 token-level dense guidance 的实现。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a failure mode in on-policy LLM distillation. Reverse KL allows the student to learn on its own rollouts and therefore fits naturally into RL-style training, but when the teacher and student distributions are far apart, the teacher mostly acts as a post-hoc scorer of bad student tokens. It does not provide a clear direction toward better tokens.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is training-signal design rather than architecture. It shows that the direction of KL and the source of sampled states can change what supervision actually means. RKL is on-policy but weakly directional. SFT is directional but off-policy. TGPO keeps student-generated states while using teacher predictions as dense token-level guidance. This is useful for reasoning distillation, early-stage RLVR for small models, and the interface between pretraining, distillation, and reinforcement learning.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper first formulates RKL distillation as an expectation over student samples and connects it to an RL objective with an intrinsic reward given by the negative student-teacher log-ratio. The weakness is that this reward only evaluates actions already sampled by the student. If a sampled token lies in a low-probability region under the teacher, the signal mainly says “do not do this,” without indicating the better action. TGPO changes the supervision path. The student still produces on-policy rollouts. For each student-generated context, the teacher is queried for its preferred next-token behavior, and the student is trained to increase the likelihood of the teacher’s token prediction on those visited states. This resembles SFT on student states rather than teacher states. The paper also discusses whether teacher information should be injected as a reward or as a regularizing loss; the central concern is preserving dense, low-variance token supervision.
summary_en.experiments: The reported evidence supports three claims. Standard RKL becomes unstable or unhelpful when the teacher-student gap is large. TGPO remains useful in such far-distribution settings because it supplies directional token supervision on the states the student actually visits. It is also reported to be competitive with mixed-policy approaches while requiring no additional annotation and remaining compatible with RLVR pipelines. The provided text does not expose the full experimental tables, model sizes, dataset details, or exact numerical deltas, so those numbers should be checked directly in the experiment section.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25-minute skim is enough for the main idea. Read Section 2 carefully, especially the derivation that rewrites RKL as an intrinsic-reward RL objective. Then inspect Figure 1 and the Section 3 objective to see where the teacher is queried and how the token-level loss is applied. In the experiments, focus on comparisons among RKL, TGPO, SFT, mixed-policy distillation, and RLVR baselines, with particular attention to stability curves and far teacher-student distribution gaps.

recommendation.zh: 读 RKL failure 分析和算法式即可；若实验规模干净，值得在内部 RLVR 蒸馏里复现。
recommendation.en: Read the RKL failure analysis and algorithm; if the scale setup is clean, it is worth reproducing inside an RLVR distillation pipeline.

paper.title: Revisiting Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards from a Contrastive Perspective
paper.abstract: RLVR has become a widely adopted paradigm for improving LLMs' reasoning capabilities, and GRPO is one of its most representative algorithms. In this paper, we first show that GRPO admits an equivalent discriminative reformulation as a weighted positive-negative score difference. Under this view, GRPO increases sequence-level scores of verified positive rollouts and decreases those of negative rollouts, where the scores are averages of clipped token-level importance sampling ratios. This reformul

summary.core_problem: GRPO作为可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）的核心算法，存在两个结构性优化缺陷：一是优化的截断重要性采样替代分数与生成阶段使用的似然不匹配，二是信用分配仅依赖采样组的正负样本通过率，对组内不同样本间的分数差距不敏感。
summary.importance: 首次明确GRPO的判别式目标等价形式，为RLVR算法优化提供了对比学习的新视角；提出的ConSPO算法可直接落地到推理类任务的RL训练流程，提升训练效率和最终模型性能。
summary.technical_approach: 首先将GRPO重写为加权正负样本判别目标的等价形式，明确其两项核心缺陷。提出的ConSPO用长度归一化的序列对数概率替换截断重要性采样分数，对齐训练目标与推理阶段的序列排序依据；再引入组级InfoNCE对比目标，让梯度依赖组内样本的相对分数，同时加入课程调度的间隔项防止梯度过早衰减。
summary.experiments: 在多个不同参数量的骨干模型、不同训练数据集上测试，ConSPO在7个数学推理基准上均取得一致的性能提升。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看Proposition 1的GRPO等价推导、图1的梯度对比，以及ConSPO目标函数的定义部分，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: As the core algorithm of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), GRPO has two structural optimization flaws: first, the optimized clipped importance sampling surrogate score is misaligned with the likelihood used in the generation phase; second, credit assignment only relies on the positive/negative sample pass rate of the sampling group, and is insensitive to the score gap between different samples in the group.
summary_en.importance: It explicitly derives the equivalent discriminative objective form of GRPO for the first time, providing a new contrastive learning perspective for RLVR algorithm optimization. The proposed ConSPO algorithm can be directly applied to RL training pipelines for reasoning tasks, improving training efficiency and final model performance.
summary_en.technical_approach: First, GRPO is rewritten into the equivalent form of a weighted positive-negative sample discrimination objective to clarify its two core flaws. The proposed ConSPO replaces clipped importance sampling scores with length-normalized sequence log-probabilities, aligning the training objective with the sequence ranking basis in the inference phase; then a group-level InfoNCE contrastive objective is introduced to make gradients depend on the relative scores of samples within the group, and a curriculum-scheduled margin is added to prevent premature gradient attenuation.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on multiple backbone models with different parameter sizes and different training datasets, ConSPO achieves consistent performance improvements on 7 mathematical reasoning benchmarks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the equivalent derivation of GRPO in Proposition 1, the gradient comparison in Figure 1, and the definition of ConSPO's objective function. Estimated reading time is 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: GRPO的本质重构和缺陷分析，做RL后训练的研究员可直接参考ConSPO的损失设计，重点看§2的等价推导
recommendation.en: Essential reformulation and defect analysis of GRPO, RL post-training researchers can directly reference ConSPO loss design, focus on §2 equivalence derivation

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: TMPO: Trajectory Matching Policy Optimization for Diverse and Efficient Diffusion Alignment
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has shown extraordinary potential in aligning diffusion models to downstream tasks, yet most of them still suffer from significant reward hacking, which degrades generative diversity and quality by inducing visual mode collapse and amplifying unreliable rewards. We identify the root cause as the mode-seeking nature of these methods, which maximize expected reward without effectively constraining probability distribution over acceptable trajectories, causing concentrat

summary.core_problem: 现有RL对齐扩散/流匹配生成模型的方法普遍存在奖励黑客问题，根源是标量奖励最大化目标本身的模式寻求特性，导致生成多样性下降、不可靠奖励被放大，出现视觉模式坍缩；现有缓解方案要么KL正则效果有限，要么GFlowNet类方法需要估计难以处理的状态流函数，引入额外训练误差。
summary.importance: 从优化目标根源上解决扩散模型RL对齐的奖励黑客问题，轨迹级分布匹配的思路可以迁移到LLM的RL对齐以缓解模式坍缩问题，树采样的效率优化也可借鉴到多轨迹采样的训练效率提升场景。
summary.technical_approach: 提出轨迹匹配策略优化（TMPO），将优化目标从标量奖励最大化改为轨迹级奖励分布匹配，核心设计包括：1）Softmax轨迹平衡（Softmax-TB）目标，对完整去噪轨迹做奖励分布匹配，将同一起点的K条轨迹的生成概率匹配到基于奖励的玻尔兹曼分布，组内归一化消除配分函数，支持直接优化；2）动态随机树采样，让轨迹共享去噪步骤，减少冗余计算，降低训练时间，同时促进不同去噪阶段的有效探索。
summary.experiments: 在FLUX.1-dev模型上测试三个对齐任务：组合图像生成、视觉文本渲染、人类偏好对齐，平均生成多样性比现有领先方法提升9.1%，同时取得最优的GenEval准确率和PickScore，训练时间最多减少27%，在奖励-多样性、奖励-效率的权衡上表现最优。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：先看引言部分对扩散模型RL对齐奖励黑客根源的分析，方法部分的Softmax-TB目标推导和动态树采样设计，实验部分的多样性和效率对比结果，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing RL alignment methods for diffusion and flow-matching generative models suffer from severe reward hacking, rooted in the mode-seeking nature of scalar reward maximization objectives, leading to reduced generative diversity, amplified unreliable rewards and visual mode collapse. Existing mitigation methods either have limited effect with KL regularization, or introduce extra training error by requiring intractable state-flow function estimation for GFlowNet-based approaches.
summary_en.importance: It addresses reward hacking in diffusion model RL alignment from the root of optimization objectives. The trajectory-level distribution matching idea can be migrated to LLM RL alignment to mitigate mode collapse, and the tree sampling efficiency optimization can be referenced for multi-trajectory sampling training efficiency improvement.
summary_en.technical_approach: Trajectory Matching Policy Optimization (TMPO) replaces scalar reward maximization with trajectory-level reward distribution matching. Core designs include: 1) Softmax Trajectory Balance (Softmax-TB) objective, which performs reward distribution matching on complete denoising trajectories, matching generation probabilities of K trajectories from the same starting point to a reward-based Boltzmann distribution, with in-group normalization to eliminate partition function for direct optimization; 2) Dynamic Stochastic Tree Sampling, which allows trajectories to share denoising steps to reduce redundant computation and training time, while promoting effective exploration across different denoising stages.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on FLUX.1-dev across three alignment tasks: compositional image generation, visual text rendering and human preference alignment. TMPO improves average generative diversity by 9.1% over existing leading methods, achieves the best GenEval accuracy and PickScore, reduces training time by up to 27%, and obtains the most favorable trade-offs on reward-diversity and reward-efficiency.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the analysis of the root cause of reward hacking in diffusion RL alignment in the Introduction section, the derivation of Softmax-TB objective and dynamic tree sampling design in the Methodology section, and the diversity and efficiency comparison results in the experiment section. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 扩散模型RL对齐的新方法，核心优化思路可迁移到Diffusion LM的对齐工作，只看§3的目标推导即可。
recommendation.en: Novel method for RL alignment of diffusion models, core optimization idea can be transferred to Diffusion LM alignment, only read §3 objective derivation.

paper.title: Breaking $\textit{Winner-Takes-All}$: Cooperative Policy Optimization Improves Diverse LLM Reasoning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiers (RLVR) has become a central paradigm for improving LLM reasoning, yet popular group-based optimization algorithms like GRPO often suffer from exploration collapse, where the models prematurely converge on a narrow set of high-scoring patterns, lacking the ability to explore new solutions. Recent efforts attempt to alleviate this by adding entropy regularization or diversity bonus. However, these approaches do not change the \textit{winner-takes-all} nature,

summary.core_problem: 现有基于组的带验证器强化学习（RLVR）优化算法如GRPO存在探索坍塌问题，模型过早收敛到狭窄的高分推理模式，现有熵正则、多样性奖励等方案未改变赢者通吃的竞争本质，无法平衡推理质量与真实推理路径多样性的矛盾。
summary.importance: 为RLVR阶段的推理多样性优化提供了协作式训练的新方向，避免纯正则方案带来的奖励目标冲突，可直接适配现有推理增强训练流程。
summary.technical_approach: 提出组协作策略优化（GCPO），将单次采样的一组推理轨迹（rollout）视为协作团队，用行列式点过程（DPP）的L-ensemble定义团队价值，同时耦合推理正确性和路径多样性，再根据每条轨迹对团队价值的平均边际贡献重新分配奖励，将优化目标从个体竞争转向非冗余正确推理路径的覆盖。
summary.experiments: 在多领域推理基准上验证，可同时提升推理准确率和有效解的多样性，与GRPO相比无显著额外计算开销。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注第3章的团队价值定义和奖励分配机制，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing group-based Reinforcement Learning with Verifiers (RLVR) algorithms such as GRPO suffer from exploration collapse, where models prematurely converge to a narrow set of high-scoring reasoning patterns. Current solutions including entropy regularization and diversity bonuses do not change the winner-takes-all competition nature, and fail to resolve the trade-off between reasoning quality and genuine reasoning path diversity.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a new cooperative training direction for reasoning diversity optimization in the RLVR stage, avoids reward objective conflicts caused by pure regularization schemes, and can be directly adapted to existing reasoning enhancement training pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Group Cooperative Policy Optimization (GCPO), which treats a group of sampled rollouts as a cooperative team. The team value is defined via the L-ensemble of Determinantal Point Process (DPP) to couple both reasoning correctness and path diversity. Rewards are redistributed according to each rollout's average marginal contribution to the team value, shifting the optimization objective from individual competition to coverage of non-redundant correct reasoning paths.
summary_en.experiments: Validated across multi-domain reasoning benchmarks, it simultaneously improves reasoning accuracy and valid solution diversity, with no significant additional computational overhead compared to GRPO.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for team value definition and reward allocation mechanism, estimated reading time 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看的是 reward design，不是结果数字；先看它如何定义 coverage credit，若干净可直接拿去做 RLVR ablation，对 reasoning mode collapse 很对症。
recommendation.en: What matters here is the reward design, not the headline numbers; inspect the coverage-based credit assignment first, because if the setup is clean it is a very plausible fix for RLVR reasoning mode collapse.

paper.title: Hölder Policy Optimisation
paper.abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimisation (GRPO) enhances large language models by estimating advantages across a group of sampled trajectories. However, mapping these trajectory-level advantages to policy updates requires aggregating token-level probabilities within each sequence. Relying on a fixed aggregation mechanism for this step fundamentally limits the algorithm's adaptability. Empirically, we observe a critical trade-off: certain fixed aggregations frequently suffer from training collapse, whi

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是 GRPO 类算法中 token 概率聚合方式过于固定的问题：把 trajectory-level advantage 转成 token-level policy update 时，不同聚合函数会在稀疏信号利用和梯度方差之间产生明显取舍。
summary.importance: 这篇论文属于 post-train/RL 优化方法，对预训练研究的间接启发在于训练信号如何被放大、平滑和稳定化。长链推理训练常见的问题不是只有 reward 设计，也包括 advantage 如何传递到每个 token。HölderPO 给出了一个统一视角，把 GRPO 的算术平均、GSPO/GMPO 的几何平均放进同一族聚合函数中，并用可调参数解释不同任务上的训练稳定性差异。它不是预训练方法，但对 RLVR 与 reasoning model 的训练动态有实用参考。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是用 Hölder mean 统一 token-level probability ratio 的聚合。参数 p 控制聚合形态：p=1 对应算术平均，p 趋近 0 对应几何平均，其他正负取值则在两者之外提供连续调节。作者给出的分析是双向取舍：较大的 p 会把梯度权重集中到少数 token 上，更容易放大稀疏但关键的学习信号；代价是方差边界变松，训练更容易不稳。较小或负的 p 会压低方差，有利于收敛稳定；代价是会削弱稀疏高价值 token 的影响。基于这个观察，HölderPO 不是固定一个 p，而是采用动态 annealing：训练早期用较大的正 p 强化稀疏信号，后期逐步转向负 p 以控制方差。
summary.experiments: 主要实验基于 Qwen2.5-Math-7B。作者先展示不同任务对 p 的偏好不同：AIME 这类稀疏信号任务在 p=3 附近表现更好，MATH500 这类更密集信号任务在 p=-1 附近更稳。固定 p=3 时，AIME accuracy 达到 46.7%，高于文中列出的 43.3% 对照记录。使用动态 p annealing 后，五个数学 benchmark 的平均准确率为 54.9%，相对标准 GRPO 提升 7.2%。评测包括 AIME、AMC、MATH、Minerva 和 OlympiadBench。方法还在 ALFWorld 上报告 93.8% success rate，相对 GRPO 的 72.8% 有 28.8% 相对提升。需要关注的是，不同任务的 reward 密度定义、p schedule 的敏感性、以及是否在更大模型和更长训练预算下保持同样结论。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20 分钟。先看引言和 Figure 1，理解 p 对 AIME24 与 MATH500 的相反影响。再看理论部分中梯度权重分布和方差边界的推导，重点判断结论依赖哪些近似。实验部分优先看 p 的网格消融、动态 annealing schedule、与 GRPO/GSPO/GMPO/PMPO 的对比。若用于复现实验，应重点检查 reward normalization、长度归一化、KL 约束、采样组大小和 p schedule，这些因素会显著影响结论。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a specific weakness in GRPO-style training: trajectory-level advantages must be mapped to token-level policy updates, and the fixed aggregation function used for token probabilities creates a trade-off between exploiting sparse learning signals and controlling gradient variance.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training optimization paper, but it is relevant to researchers studying training dynamics for reasoning models. It shifts attention from reward design alone to how reward-derived advantages are distributed over tokens. HölderPO provides a unified lens for arithmetic-mean GRPO and geometric-mean variants such as GSPO or GMPO, and explains why different reasoning tasks may prefer different aggregation regimes.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method replaces a fixed token-probability aggregation rule with the Hölder mean. The parameter p controls the aggregation shape: p=1 recovers the arithmetic mean, p approaching 0 recovers the geometric mean, and other positive or negative values provide a continuous family of update rules. The paper characterizes a two-sided trade-off. Larger p concentrates gradient weight on a smaller set of tokens, which can amplify rare but informative signals in sparse-reward reasoning tasks. The cost is a looser variance bound and higher risk of unstable updates. Smaller or negative p tightens variance and improves stability, but it can smooth away rare high-value token contributions. The proposed practical instantiation uses p annealing: start with a larger positive p to exploit sparse signals, then move toward a negative p to stabilize convergence.
summary_en.experiments: The main experiments use Qwen2.5-Math-7B. The ablations show task-dependent sensitivity to p: AIME-style sparse-signal tasks prefer larger positive values, with AIME24 peaking around p=3, while denser tasks such as MATH500 prefer lower or negative values, with a reported peak around p=-1. With fixed p=3, AIME accuracy reaches 46.7%, compared with the 43.3% reference reported by the authors. With dynamic p annealing, HölderPO reaches 54.9% average accuracy over five math benchmarks: AIME, AMC, MATH, Minerva, and OlympiadBench. This is reported as a 7.2% relative gain over standard GRPO. The method also reports a 93.8% success rate on ALFWorld, compared with 72.8% for GRPO. The main points to verify are reward-density definitions, sensitivity of the p schedule, and whether the same behavior holds for larger models and longer RL runs.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20 minute skim is appropriate. Start with the introduction and Figure 1 to see why AIME24 and MATH500 prefer different p values. Then read the theoretical section on gradient weight concentration and variance bounds, focusing on the assumptions behind the trade-off. In the experiments, prioritize the p-grid ablation, the annealing schedule, and comparisons against GRPO, GSPO, GMPO, and PMPO. For reproduction, pay close attention to reward normalization, length handling, KL control, group size, and the exact p schedule.

recommendation.zh: 只需看第3章的理论推导和第4.2节的实验结果，可直接用于内部RL对齐实验的baseline改进
recommendation.en: Only read theoretical derivation in §3 and experimental results in §4.2, can be directly used to improve RL alignment baseline in internal experiments

paper.title: Rethinking Importance Sampling in LLM Policy Optimization: A Cumulative Token Perspective
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning, including reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), has emerged as a powerful approach for LLM post-training. Central to these approaches is the design of the importance sampling (IS) ratio used in off-policy policy-gradient estimation. Existing methods face a fundamental bias-variance dilemma: token-level IS ratios, as adopted by PPO (Schulman et al., 2017) and GRPO (Shao et al., 2024), introduce bias by ignoring prefix state distribution mismatch; full sequ

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM离策略（off-policy）策略优化中的重要性采样（IS）存在根本性的偏方差权衡困境：GRPO采用的token级IS忽略前缀状态分布不匹配，引入系统偏差；全序列IS可提供精确的轨迹级修正，但token概率的连乘导致方差极高；GSPO通过长度归一化的序列级IS提升数值稳定性，但偏离了严格的IS修正定义，同样存在偏差。该缺陷是当前GRPO系后训练算法（含可验证奖励强化学习RLVR）的核心底层问题，直接影响梯度估计质量和训练效果。
summary.importance: 该工作从理论层面定位了现有主流RL后训练算法在IS设计上的根本缺陷，提出的累积token IS比率在理论上无偏，且方差严格低于全序列IS，解决了长期存在的偏方差权衡问题。提出的位置自适应截断方法解决了累积IS实际落地中的正则不一致问题。最终得到的CTPO算法可直接替换工业界广泛使用的GRPO，对推理类任务的RL后训练效果有可落地的提升。该工作属于后训练优化算法的底层范式改进，直接关联预训练-后训练闭环的核心优化。
summary.technical_approach: 该工作首先在token级策略梯度框架下，推导了累积token IS比率（第t个位置及之前所有token级IS的乘积）的两个核心性质：一是该比率对每个token的梯度项提供无偏的前缀分布修正，因为它完整覆盖了当前前缀在行为策略和目标策略下的似然差；二是其方差严格低于全序列IS，因为t位置之后的后缀token在行为策略下的期望为1，只会引入不必要的方差，无法降低偏差。针对累积IS的对数方差随token位置线性增长（Var(logρ_t^cum) = tσ²），固定截断阈值会导致早期token几乎不被截断、后期token被过度截断的正则不一致问题，该工作提出位置自适应截断策略：截断阈值随√t线性缩放，匹配累积对数IS的标准差增长规律，实现不同位置token的正则强度一致。基于以上两点，该工作提出CTPO（累积token策略优化）算法。
summary.experiments: 实验在工具集成推理（TIR）设置下开展，即模型迭代生成并执行沙箱环境中的Python代码解决复杂数学题。对比GRPO、GSPO等强基线，CTPO在多个模型尺度下均取得最高的平均性能。消融实验验证了位置自适应截断对最终性能的显著贡献。
summary.reading_guide: 重点精读累积token IS比率无偏性和方差性质的理论推导部分，这是核心创新的理论基础。其次关注位置自适应截断的动机和推导逻辑。实验部分优先查看不同IS策略的偏方差对比可视化，以及自适应截断的消融实验图表。附录中的完整理论证明可进一步深挖，训练过程中不同位置token的截断频率统计，也能直观体现固定截断的缺陷。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing importance sampling (IS) designs for off-policy LLM policy optimization suffer from a fundamental bias-variance tradeoff: token-level IS used in GRPO ignores prefix state distribution mismatch and introduces systematic bias; full-sequence IS provides exact trajectory-level correction but suffers from extremely high variance due to multiplicative accumulation of per-token probabilities; GSPO's length-normalized sequence-level IS improves numerical stability but deviates from strict IS correction definitions and remains biased. This is a core underlying flaw of mainstream GRPO-family post-training algorithms, including reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), that directly degrades gradient estimation quality and training performance.
summary_en.importance: This work identifies the fundamental theoretical flaw in IS design of state-of-the-art RL post-training algorithms, and proposes a cumulative token IS ratio that is theoretically unbiased and has strictly lower variance than full-sequence IS, resolving the long-standing bias-variance dilemma. The proposed position-adaptive clipping strategy solves the regularization inconsistency issue in practical cumulative IS deployment. The resulting CTPO algorithm can directly replace the widely used GRPO in industrial settings, delivering measurable improvements to RL post-training for reasoning tasks. It represents a low-level paradigm improvement for post-training optimization, directly relevant to the pretrain-posttrain closed loop.
summary_en.technical_approach: Under the token-level policy gradient framework, this work derives two core properties of the cumulative token IS ratio, defined as the product of all per-token IS ratios up to position t. First, this ratio provides unbiased prefix distribution correction for gradient terms at each token position, as it fully accounts for the likelihood difference of the current prefix under the behavior and target policies. Second, its variance is strictly lower than full-sequence IS, since suffix tokens beyond position t have unit expectation under the behavior policy and only introduce unnecessary variance without reducing bias. To address the issue that the log variance of cumulative IS grows linearly with token position (Var(logρ_t^cum) = tσ²), which causes inconsistent regularization where early tokens are rarely clipped and late tokens are over-clipped under a fixed clipping threshold, this work proposes a position-adaptive clipping strategy that scales clipping thresholds proportionally to √t, matching the standard deviation growth of cumulative log IS and achieving consistent regularization intensity across all token positions. These two insights form the CTPO (Cumulative Token Policy Optimization) algorithm.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are conducted in the tool-integrated reasoning (TIR) setting, where models iteratively generate and execute Python code in a sandboxed environment to solve challenging mathematical problems. Compared to strong baselines including GRPO and GSPO, CTPO achieves the highest average performance across multiple model scales. Ablation studies confirm that position-adaptive clipping makes a statistically significant contribution to final performance.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the theoretical derivations of the unbiasedness and variance properties of the cumulative token IS ratio, which forms the core theoretical foundation of the work. Then review the motivation and derivation logic of position-adaptive clipping. For experiments, prioritize visualizations comparing bias and variance across different IS strategies, as well as ablation results for adaptive clipping. Full theoretical proofs in the appendix are worth deep diving, and statistics of clipping frequency across token positions during training provide intuitive understanding of the limitation of fixed clipping.

recommendation.zh: 从理论上修正了PPO/GRPO等主流RL算法的梯度估计偏差问题，是后训练算法迭代的核心参考，应立刻复现并做内部ablation
recommendation.en: Theoretically corrects the gradient estimation bias in mainstream RL algorithms like PPO/GRPO, a core reference for post-training algorithm iteration; immediately replicate and run internal ablation.

paper.title: Gradient Extrapolation-Based Policy Optimization
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning is widely used to improve the reasoning ability of large language models, especially when answers can be automatically checked. Standard GRPO-style training updates the model using only the current step, while full multi-step lookahead can give a better update direction but is too expensive because it needs many backward passes. We propose Gradient Extrapolation-Based Policy Optimization (GXPO), a plug-compatible policy-update rule for GRPO-style reasoning RL. GXPO approxi

summary.core_problem: 现有GRPO风格的LLM推理强化学习仅使用单步梯度更新，多步前瞻更新需要多次反向传播，计算成本过高，难以融入现有训练流水线。
summary.importance: 为RL后训练（尤其是推理类RL）提供了兼容GRPO、无额外数据成本的优化器侧更新策略，仅需3次反向传播即可近似多步前瞻更新的效果，可直接提升训练效率和最终模型性能。
summary.technical_approach: 提出梯度外推策略优化（GXPO），复用同一批rollout、奖励、优势函数和GRPO损失，仅修改策略更新逻辑：首先用2次快速探空梯度步计算梯度坐标的保留比例，通过几何外推近似多步更新后的参数位置，最后在该位置执行1次校正梯度更新；同时加入滚动z-score门控，当校正梯度范数不稳定时自动回退到单步更新。
summary.experiments: 在两类模型族的MATH、GSM8K等推理任务上测试，相同计算预算下性能优于基线GRPO；消融实验验证了外推步和门控机制的有效性，虚拟前瞻深度K的增加不会带来额外的反向传播开销。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第3节的方法实现部分和实验章节的消融结果，预计阅读时间20分钟，无需深入研究二次项替代的理论推导细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing GRPO-style RL for LLM reasoning only uses single-step gradient updates, while multi-step lookahead updates require multiple backward passes with excessive computational cost, and cannot be easily integrated into existing training pipelines.
summary_en.importance: Provides a GRPO-compatible optimizer-side update strategy for RL post-training (especially reasoning-focused RL) with no extra data cost, which approximates the effect of multi-step lookahead updates with only 3 backward passes, and directly improves training efficiency and final model performance.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Gradient Extrapolation-Based Policy Optimization (GXPO), which reuses the same batch of rollouts, rewards, advantage functions, and GRPO loss, and only modifies the policy update logic: first compute the retention ratio of gradient coordinates with 2 fast probe gradient steps, approximate the parameter position after multi-step updates via geometric extrapolation, and finally run 1 corrective gradient update at the extrapolated position. A rolling z-score gate is added to automatically fall back to single-step updates when the corrective gradient norm is unstable.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on reasoning tasks including MATH and GSM8K across two model families, outperforms baseline GRPO under the same computational budget. Ablation studies verify the effectiveness of the extrapolation step and gating mechanism, and the increase of virtual lookahead depth K does not introduce extra backward pass overhead.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the method implementation in Section 3 and ablation results in the experiment section, expected reading time ~20 minutes, no need to dive into detailed theoretical derivations of quadratic surrogate models.

recommendation.zh: 只看算法和成本表就够；若实验干净，GXPO 值得在内部 GRPO/RLVR 配方里小规模复现。
recommendation.en: Read the algorithm and cost table; if the experiments are clean, GXPO deserves a small internal GRPO/RLVR reproduction.

institutions: Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology

paper.title: POETS: Uncertainty-Aware LLM Optimization via Compute-Efficient Policy Ensembles
paper.abstract: Balancing exploration and exploitation is a core challenge in sequential decision-making and black-box optimization. We introduce POETS ($\textbf{Po}$licy $\textbf{E}$nsembles for $\textbf{T}$hompson $\textbf{S}$ampling), a novel framework that bridges uncertainty quantification and policy optimization. Our approach is grounded in the insight that policies trained with Kullback-Leibler (KL) regularization implicitly encode an underlying reward function. Building on this, POETS bypasses the compl

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的是：在 LLM policy optimization 和组合黑盒优化里，如何获得可用的 epistemic uncertainty，用来做更有效的探索，同时避免显式训练不确定性 reward model 和完整 LLM ensemble 的高成本。
summary.importance: 它对预训练研究的直接性不强，但对 post-train 与 pretrain 接口有参考价值。核心启发是把 KL-regularized policy 看成隐式 reward model：策略分布本身编码了相对 reference policy 的 reward 信息。这样可以绕开“先学 reward model、再优化 policy”的两阶段流程，把不确定性建模放到 policy ensemble 上。对做 RL pretrain、verifiable RL、GRPO 变体和在线数据生成的人来说，比较有用的点是：它给 experience replay 和探索提供了一个可计算的 uncertainty 接口，而不是只依赖 outcome reward 或单一 teacher/reward model。
summary.technical_approach: POETS 建在 KL 正则化控制的 policy-reward duality 上。给定 reference policy，KL-regularized optimal policy 可以反推出一个隐式 reward，形式上接近 log pi 与 log pi_ref 的差，再乘以温度系数。论文利用这个关系，不显式拟合 reward model，而是训练多个 policy，使它们隐式编码的 reward 与在线观测到的 bootstrapped 数据一致。为了让 ensemble 表示 epistemic uncertainty，每条新样本对每个 ensemble member 采样一个 Poisson(1) 权重，这相当于在线 bootstrap，适合 sequential data collection 和 replay buffer。推理或采样时，可以从 ensemble 中选一个 policy 执行，近似 Thompson sampling。为降低 LLM ensemble 成本，模型采用 Trunk & Branch 结构：大部分 backbone 参数共享，只在分支上放独立的 LoRA 模块来承载 ensemble 差异。这个设计比独立训练多个 LLM 便宜，也比只用 dropout 之类的随机扰动更接近 bootstrap ensemble 的统计语义。
summary.experiments: 论文给出 KL-regularized Thompson sampling 风格的理论保证，累计 soft regret 界为 O(sqrt(T gamma_T))，其中 gamma_T 是 maximal information gain，用来刻画有效问题维度。实验覆盖组合黑盒优化场景，包括蛋白设计和量子电路设计。作者报告 POETS 在样本效率上优于对照方法，并且在 GRPO 训练中改善优化轨迹，使 experience replay 更可用，减少过早过拟合。提供的全文片段没有给出具体模型参数量、LoRA rank、ensemble size、token budget、各 benchmark 的绝对分数和提升幅度，因此这些数字不应补写。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 30–45 分钟。重点看三处：第一，Introduction 和 Figure 1，理解它为什么不训练显式 reward model；第二，Preliminaries 中 KL-regularized policy 与 reward 的对偶关系，这是方法成立的关键；第三，Poisson bootstrapping 与 Trunk & Branch 设计，判断它的 uncertainty 是否足够稳健。实验部分优先看 GRPO + experience replay 的曲线，以及 ensemble 成本、样本效率、过拟合行为的消融。如果只关心基座预训练，可以略过具体蛋白和量子电路任务，把它当作 uncertainty-aware RL/post-train 方法来看。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how to obtain useful epistemic uncertainty for LLM policy optimization and combinatorial black-box optimization without training an explicit uncertainty-aware reward model or maintaining a full ensemble of large models.
summary_en.importance: The work is not a pretraining method in the narrow sense, but it is relevant to the pretrain–posttrain interface. Its useful idea is to treat a KL-regularized policy as an implicit reward model: the policy distribution, relative to a reference policy, carries reward information. This turns exploration from a reward-modeling problem into a policy-ensemble problem. For RL pretraining, verifiable RL, GRPO variants, and online data generation, the main value is a concrete uncertainty mechanism that can support exploration and experience replay instead of relying only on a single reward model or sparse outcome rewards.
summary_en.technical_approach: POETS relies on the duality between KL-regularized optimal policies and rewards. Given a reference policy, the optimal policy implicitly defines a reward through the log-ratio between the optimized policy and the reference policy, up to scaling and normalization terms. The method trains an ensemble of policies whose implicit rewards match online observed data. Diversity is induced with online Poisson bootstrapping: each incoming sample receives an independent Poisson(1) weight for each ensemble member, which approximates bootstrap resampling while remaining compatible with sequential data collection and replay buffers. Action selection can then sample an ensemble member, giving a Thompson-sampling-like exploration rule. To make this feasible for LLMs, POETS uses a Trunk & Branch architecture: the backbone is shared and evaluated once, while independent LoRA branches carry the ensemble-specific variation. This is cheaper than independent full-model ensembles and has a clearer uncertainty interpretation than simple stochastic perturbations.
summary_en.experiments: The paper states a soft-regret guarantee of O(sqrt(T gamma_T)) for KL-regularized Thompson sampling, where gamma_T denotes maximal information gain and captures the effective dimension of the problem. Empirically, the method is evaluated on combinatorial black-box optimization tasks, including protein design and quantum circuit design. The authors also report that POETS improves GRPO optimization trajectories and makes experience replay more usable by reducing premature overfitting. The provided full-content excerpt does not include exact model sizes, LoRA ranks, ensemble sizes, token budgets, absolute benchmark numbers, or per-task improvement margins, so those details should be checked in the experiment tables before citing.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 30–45 minutes. Focus on three parts: the Introduction and Figure 1 for the motivation against explicit reward modeling; the preliminaries on KL-regularized policy–reward duality, which is the key mechanism; and the Poisson bootstrap plus Trunk & Branch implementation, which determines whether the uncertainty estimate is credible at LLM scale. In the experiments, prioritize GRPO with experience replay, sample-efficiency curves, ensemble-cost analysis, and overfitting behavior. If the goal is foundation-model pretraining, the protein and quantum-circuit applications can be read as testbeds rather than the main contribution.

recommendation.zh: 把KL正则化策略隐式编码奖励函数的洞察用于不确定性感知RL，对设计更高效的RLHF/RL推理训练管线有启发。只看§3的核心架构设计即可
recommendation.en: The insight that KL-regularized policies implicitly encode reward functions is useful for designing more efficient RLHF/RL reasoning pipelines. Read only §3 for the core architectural design

paper.title: A$^2$TGPO: Agentic Turn-Group Policy Optimization with Adaptive Turn-level Clipping
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning for agentic large language models (LLMs) typically relies on a sparse, trajectory-level outcome reward, making it difficult to evaluate the contribution of individual tool-calls within multi-turn interactions. Existing approaches to such process credit assignment either depend on separate external process reward models that introduce additional consumption, or tree-based structural rollout that merely redistributes the outcome signal while constraining trajectory diversity

summary.core_problem: 解决 agentic LLM 在多轮工具调用 RL 中，只有稀疏轨迹级 outcome reward 时难以给单个 turn 做稳定 credit assignment 的问题。
summary.importance: 这是后训练方向里较贴近基座研究的问题：如何在不引入外部 process reward model 的情况下，为多步 agent RL 构造更细粒度、低偏差的训练信号。对 RL-pretrain 接口和 process supervision 都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 A²TGPO，用 turn-group policy optimization 结合 adaptive turn-level clipping。论文以 Information Gain（每轮 ground-truth 概率变化）作为内生过程信号，试图避免外部 evaluator 成本；同时针对 prior IG-RL 的三个问题做修正：跨 turn 归一化失真、可变项数累积导致 advantage 尺度不稳、以及 turn 级更新过激。核心创新应在 turn-group 聚合与自适应 clipping 机制上。
summary.experiments: 摘要未完整给出 benchmark 和数值，但定位很明确：与依赖 outcome reward、外部 process reward model 或树式 rollout 的方法比较，目标是在多轮 agent 交互中获得更稳定、更高效的 RL 训练。由于目前只见摘要，可信度主要取决于 ablation 是否把 IG、grouping、clipping 三者拆干净。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自腾讯、香港中文大学、深圳北理莫斯科大学。腾讯在 agent 与后训练方向持续有产出，这篇更像对 process credit assignment 的系统化修补。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles unstable credit assignment in RL for agentic LLMs, where sparse trajectory-level outcome rewards make it hard to evaluate individual tool-use turns in multi-turn interactions.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training paper, but one that matters to foundation-model researchers because it addresses how to build finer-grained, lower-bias learning signals for multi-step agent RL without relying on external process reward models.
summary_en.technical_approach: A²TGPO introduces agentic turn-group policy optimization with adaptive turn-level clipping. It uses Information Gain—the per-turn change in the policy's predicted probability of the ground truth—as an intrinsic process signal, then corrects three issues in prior IG-based RL: distorted cross-turn normalization, unstable advantage scales from summing variable numbers of terms, and overly aggressive turn-level updates. The main novelty appears to be turn-group aggregation plus adaptive clipping.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide full benchmark details or exact numbers, but the intended comparison is clear: against sparse outcome-reward RL, external process reward models, and tree-structured rollout methods. The main thing to verify in the full paper is whether the ablations cleanly isolate the effects of IG, grouping, and clipping.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Tencent, CUHK, and Shenzhen MSU-BIT University. Tencent has been active in agent and post-training work; this paper looks like a systematic attempt to repair process credit assignment.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得从 RL-pretrain 接口角度看：若 IG 真能替代外部 process reward，训练信号设计会更便宜；先看方法节和 ablation，重点查 grouping+clipping 是否真比 reward hacking 更干净。
recommendation.en: Read this from the RL–pretrain interface angle: if IG can really replace external process rewards, signal design gets much cheaper; focus on the method and ablations to see whether grouping plus clipping is actually cleaner than reward hacking.
